name: Bousou! Justice
source:
A secret evil organization started to send combatants to a certain high school to make uproar. Main character together with some girls have formed "friends of justice" circle to fight that organization. 

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/11/vn-of-month-november-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
一个秘密邪恶组织开始派出战斗人员到某高中闹事。主角与一些女孩组成了“正义之友”圈子来对抗该组织。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/11/vn-of-month-november-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
